verdict.rationale: Mesh documents that a customer can be a company and that customers are screened against sanctions, PEP, watchlist and adverse-media data, so screening business entities is covered. Nothing in the pack shows how linked ownership or association risk can be inspected. missing for 10: documented beneficial-ownership or UBO data, linked-entity or association risk views, network/relationship inspection, independent or hands-on corroboration of business-entity screening.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can screen business entities and inspect their linked ownership or association risk context

citations.quote: A customer is a person or company that has a direct relationship with your company.
you can check your customers against a global database of Sanctions, Warning, Fitness and Probity and Watchlists, Politically Exposed Persons registers (PEPs) and Adverse Media.
